name: io.github.phm-audit/phm-lite-check
title: PHM Physics Check
description: Deterministic physics plausibility checking for LLM outputs and robotics datasets: unit consistency, speed-of-light limit, probability ranges, kinematics, quaternion normalization, timestamp sanity, NaN/Inf scan. Pure stdlib rules, zero network, sub-millisecond verdicts. Offline subset of the PHM engine; checks are necessary, not sufficient.
